استسغن (form X)
# اِسْتَسَغْنَ (istasaḡna) /is.ta.saɣ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَسَاغَ (istasāḡa)
# اُسْتُسِغْنَ (ustusiḡna) /us.tu.siɣ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَسَاغَ (istasāḡa)
# اِسْتَسِغْنَ (istasiḡna) /is.ta.siɣ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَسَاغَ (istasāḡa)
